read.thesis: Gildan's Q1 reads as an inventory-destocking and Hanes-integration story: wholesale sales fell to $552M from $626M, FCF was -$310M, and FY26 guidance was held with Q2 sales guided to about $1.6B.

capex.quote: capital expenditures planned at 3% of net sales

triggers.label: Voluntary channel destocking hits sell-in
triggers.quote: lower volumes stemming from our proactive inventory reduction across customer channels
triggers.highlight: proactive inventory reduction across customer channels

triggers.label: Wholesale sales $552M vs $626M
triggers.quote: Net sales were $552 million compared to $626 million in the prior year

triggers.label: Adj. gross margin 33% vs 31.2%
triggers.quote: adjusted gross profit was $385 million or 33% of net sales compared to 31.2% in the prior year

triggers.label: FY26 guidance held; Q2 sales ~$1.6B
triggers.quote: we are maintaining our guidance as follows: revenue of $6 billion to $6.2 billion

guidance.quote: full year adjusted operating margin of approximately 20%
Adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $4.20 to $4.40
free cash flow to be above $850 million
We expect net sales from continuing operations to be approximately $1.6 billion.
approximately $250 million in run rate cost synergies over the next 3 years including approximately $100 million in 2026

red_flags.label: Free cash flow -$310M in Q1
red_flags.quote: the company consumed approximately $310 million of free cash flow

red_flags.label: Leverage 3.3x net debt/EBITDA
red_flags.quote: a leverage ratio of 3.3x net debt to trailing 12 months pro forma adjusted EBITDA

evasions.quote: although I going to give you a full quantification of that, what I can tell you is we have visibility

evasions.topic: Gross margin and SG&A targets for the year
evasions.quote: We're not providing a specific guide on the gross margin and the SG&A in isolation.

evasions.topic: Pricing strategy for rising input costs
evasions.quote: So look, we'll wait and see.
